dishes.name: Diyarbakır liver kebab
dishes.desc: Lamb liver cut into small pieces and grilled on skewers, often eaten at breakfast with bread, onion and sumac. It has protected geographical status here.

dishes.name: Mumbar dolması
dishes.desc: Sheep intestine stuffed with rice, minced meat and spices, then boiled and fried. A famously Diyarbakır dish sold in many local restaurants.

dishes.name: Meftune
dishes.desc: Slow-cooked lamb with seasonal vegetables in a sweet-and-sour sauce, with a touch of dried fruit. A traditional Diyarbakır home dish.

dishes.name: Duvaklı pilav
dishes.desc: Spiced rice with meat, topped with a pastry lid that is lifted at the table like a veil. A festive dish served in Diyarbakır restaurants.

dishes.name: Burma kadayıf
dishes.desc: Rolled shredded pastry with pistachio or walnut in syrup, a staple of Diyarbakır sweet shops. The city also serves Nuriye, a similar pastry.
